name: Elif Demir
bio:
Elif Demir's motorsport journey began unexpectedly, while working as a project manager for a large engineering firm in Istanbul. Tasked with overseeing the construction of a new grandstand at Istanbul Park, she became captivated by the energy and precision of the racing world. Leaving her stable career behind, Elif pursued a role at a local racing team, quickly proving her talent for organization and problem-solving.

Over the years, Elif has steadily climbed the ranks, gaining experience in various operational roles before joining JHR Developments. Her approach to the head of operations role is methodical and detail-oriented, focusing on creating a streamlined and efficient environment where everyone can perform at their best. Elif is known for her unflappable demeanor under pressure and her ability to anticipate potential issues before they arise, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a low bun with a few loose strands framing her face.
physical.description: Elif is a woman of average height with a warm smile and a perpetually focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously noting down every detail.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, with everything in its designated place.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
